strings.name: Joe Hisaishi
strings.summary: Born Mamoru Fujisawa, Hisaishi studied composition at Kunitachi College of Music and initially explored minimalism and electronics. His long collaboration with Hayao Miyazaki began with Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind; he also scored films by Takeshi Kitano and others, using repeated motifs, melody and orchestral color in film narrative. He continues to write symphonic and solo works, connecting animation audiences and concert halls through conducting and international tours.
